notes.title: Major art Update
notes.content:
A complete new set of stylish loading and "Get Ready" screens has been added to replace the old ones. BUT! the original art still in the game and its selectable from the options menu, you choose.

The Darsalon universe has never been so well represented! Here are a few of them:
